props.name: activeTone
props.description: Color tone while pressed.

props.name: activeVariant
props.description: Visual treatment while pressed.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as.

props.name: autoLoading
props.description:
Shows loading automatically from the `onClick` handler: when it returns a promise (for example
an `async` function), the button is loading until the promise settles, whether it resolves or
rejects. A handler that calls `event.preventDefault()` does not trigger loading.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content or render function receiving reactive toggle and loading states.
A render function must declare its parameter, even when unused. A zero-argument
function is called as an accessor and is not mounted as a component.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Initial uncontrolled toggle state.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables the button, including non-button roots set with `as` (those get `aria-disabled`
and are removed from the tab order). Clicks and Enter/Space activation are ignored while
disabled.

props.name: leading
props.description: Name of an icon rendered before the label. Replaced by the loading icon while loading.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows the loading indicator. While loading the button sets `aria-busy`, ignores clicks and
keyboard activation, and stays focusable. Combine with `autoLoading` to also show loading
while an async click handler is pending.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description:
Name of the icon shown while loading. It replaces the `leading` icon, or the `trailing` icon
when only `trailing` is set; with no icons it is added before the label.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description:
Called with the new pressed state when the user activates the button, unless an `onClick`
handler calls `event.preventDefault()`. It does not fire for programmatic changes to `pressed`.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled pressed state. Leave it `undefined` for uncontrolled usage; when set, clicks only call `onPressedChange` and the button follows what you pass back.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size, including icon-only sizes.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: tone
props.description: Color tone while unpressed.

props.name: trailing
props.description:
Name of an icon rendered after the label. It is replaced by the loading icon only when no
`leading` icon is set.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment while unpressed.
